decisive_items: Positive EBV viral capsid IgM antibody
Positive EBV viral capsid IgG antibody
response.rationale: R2 is supported by two separate raw raw serological findings directly indicating infectious mononucleosis, whereas C1 only repeats one of these at a more specific level; all other diagnoses rely on non-specific or secondary findings that do not fit the complete presentation.

rejected.why: Gallstones are present but MRCP negates choledocholithiasis and clinical picture is dominated by EBV systemic features.
Raised liver enzymes are non-specific without autoimmune serology or histology.
Clarithromycin is coincidental and no temporal or specificity of injury with jaundice, rash, parotitis.
Splenomegaly is a secondary imaging finding fully explained by EBV infection.
